name: Aberrant Form
description:
Channeling the power of vile otherworldly entities into your body, you take a new grotesque form, allowing you to wade into the battlefield while spreading pain and terror in your wake. You transform yourself into a Large aberration. You must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. When you Cast this Spell, choose chuul, gogiteth, gug, or ofalth. While in this form, you gain the aberration trait. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose: AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.13 temporary Hit Points.Darkvision.One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +18, and your damage bonus is +8. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.Athletics modifier of +20, unless your own modifier is higher.You also gain specific abilities based on the type of aberration you choose:

  • Chuul Speed 30 feet, swim 25 feet; Melee [single action] claw (reach 10 feet), Damage 2d8 bludgeoning, and after a successful Strike, you can spend an action to attempt to Grab the target.
  • Gogiteth Speed 40 feet, climb 30 feet; Melee [single action] jaws, Damage 2d10 piercing, and after a successful Strike, you can spend an action to attempt to Grab the target; Melee [single action] leg (agile, reach 10 feet), Damage 2d6+8 piercing.
  • Gug Speed 40 feet, climb 20 feet; Melee [single action] jaws (reach 10 feet), Damage 2d12 piercing; Melee [single action] claw (agile, reach 10 feet), Damage 2d8+8 slashing; your multiple joints allow you to fit through tight spaces as if you were a Medium creature.
  • Ofalth Speed 30 feet; +2 circumstance bonus on saves against disease and poison; Melee [single action] fist (reach 10 feet), Damage 2d12 bludgeoning.

Heightened (6th) Your battle form is Huge, and the reach of your attacks increases by 5 feet. You must have space to expand, or the spell is lost. You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 26 temporary Hit Points, attack modifier +22, damage bonus +13, and Athletics +23.

name: Amalgamizing Leap
duration: until the end of your next turn
description:
You choose a location within range that you can see and haphazardly catapult yourself and the target through space, attempting to violate one of the cardinal laws of teleportation by intertwining your own magical signature with that of the target creature as if you both were a single being. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected, but you're instantly transported to the chosen space.

Success You and a piece of the target are transported to the chosen location, fused together. The target becomes enfeebled 1, and you gain 20 temporary Hit Points until the end of your next turn.

Failure You and the target creature vanish from your current locations and reappear in the chosen space fused together until the end of your next turn. While fused together, you also gain the following effects. You gain 40 temporary Hit Points that last for the duration of the spell.You gain all Speeds possessed by the target, unless you already have a higher Speed of that kind.You gain all special senses possessed by the target.Your reach increases by 5 feet.While fused, the target creature doesn't occupy space, is unable to act, and can't be targeted or affected by attacks or other effects. The target does remain aware of its environment and everything transpiring around it. At the end of your next turn, the target separates from you in an adjacent space. Both you and the target return to your original forms.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target also becomes sickened 1.

name: Angel Form
description:
Invoking the celestial realms, you transform into a Medium angel battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose balisse, choral, kuribu, or tennin. The battle form is Small if you choose choral or kuribu. While in this form, you gain the angel, celestial, and holy traits. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose: AC = 22 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction40 temporary Hit Points and weakness 10 to unholy.Darkvision.One or more attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +25, and your damage bonus is +12. Melee attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example), and ranged attacks are Dexterity based. If your attack modifier is higher for the given unarmed attack or weapon, you can use it instead.Athletics modifier of +25, unless your own modifier is higher.You also gain specific abilities based on the type of angel you choose:

  • Balisse Speed 30 feet, fly 40 feet; Perception modifier of +26 to detect lies and illusions unless your own modifier is higher; Melee [single action] scimitar (fire, forceful, holy, magical, sweep), Damage 2d6 slashing plus 2d6 fire.
  • Choral Speed 30 feet, fly 40 feet; +1 status bonus to AC and saves against auditory and sonic; Melee [single action] fist (agile, holy, magical, unarmed), Damage 2d6 bludgeoning; Ranged [single action] piercing hymn (holy, magical, range 90 feet), Damage 3d6 sonic and deafened for 1 round on a critical hit.
  • Kuribu Speed 25 feet, fly 40 feet; resistance 10 to electricity and fire; Melee [single action] fist (agile, holy, magical, unarmed), Damage 3d4 bludgeoning; Ranged [single action] composite shortbow (deadly 2d10, holy, magical, propulsive, range increment 60 feet), Damage 3d6 piercing.
  • Tennin Speed 30 feet, fly 60 feet; can Step into difficult terrain and use land and fly Speeds to Step; Melee [single action] fist (agile, holy, magical, nonlethal, unarmed), Damage 1d6 bludgeoning plus 1d6 cold and 1d6 spirit.

Heightened (9th) Your battle form is Large if you choose balisse or tennin. You must have space to expand into, or the spell is lost. You instead gain AC = 22 + your level, 60 temporary Hit Points, weakness 15 to unholy, attack modifier +30, damage bonus +20, and Athletics +33.

name: Animal Allies
description:
You summon tiny, ordinary animals from the environment, such as insects, birds, or fish, to quickly lash out at nearby foes. The animals swarm around the creatures in the area, dealing 3d4 piercing damage to each creature with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 3d4.

name: Appeal to Authority
description:
You implant a thought in your target’s mind that resembles an authority figure in their life, influencing how they feel about you. The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target harbors some small resentment toward the authority figure you invoked. The target takes a –1 status penalty to saves against your emotion effects, but can attempt another Will save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell’s effect on a success.

Failure The target believes the resemblance and is susceptible to your influence, taking a –1 status penalty to saves against your emotion effects.

Critical Failure As failure, except the status penalty is –2.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 4 creatures.

name: Approximate
description:
Your magic quickly flows over an area to help you count and catalog. Name a particular type of object you're looking for within the area. You gain an instant estimate of the quantity of the chosen objects that are clearly visible within the target area. The number is rounded to the largest digit. For example, you could look at a pile of 180 copper coins, and you would learn that it held about 200 coins, but you couldn't determine there were exactly 180 coins.

The type of object you name can be as specific or general as you like—“dented copper coins” is as viable as “coins”—but the distinguishing features must be obvious at a glance, and the spell is fooled by objects disguised as other objects.

name: Artistic Recollection
description: You touch your finger to a blank surface and create an image of a person, place, or object. This image appears instantly in the style of a pastel-hued oil painting and disappears cleanly once the spell ends. The portrait is the size of one average sketchbook page and must represent a subject the caster has seen in person or has studied extensively.

name: Ash Cloud
description:
You summon a tumultuous cloud of ash and smoke. The cloud is difficult terrain for flying creatures, and creatures in the cloud can't detect anything using their sense of smell. Creatures that start their turn within the cloud take 2d4 fire damage as their lungs fill with the hot, acrid smoke, with a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is dazzled for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is blinded for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

name: Befitting Attire
description:
You cloak the targets in an illusion, shaping their clothing and worn items into ones suitable for a particular occasion. You visualize the occasion, and the spell creates illusory attire customized to each target. For instance, if you visualized a noble ball, armor would appear to be fine clothing. This doesn't change identifying details of the targets' appearances other than their clothes.

Any creature that touches the attire, uses the Seek action to examine it, or otherwise interacts with it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 20 creatures.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 100 creatures.

name: Begone
description:
With but a touch, a mystical force sends a foe rocketing backward. The target creature must attempt a Fortitude save. If the creature's movement causes it to hit a firm surface, such as a wall, it takes 5 bludgeoning damage. A creature knocked off a ledge or the like can Grab an Edge to avoid falling.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pushed 5 feet away from you.

Failure The creature is pushed 15 feet away from you.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 30 feet away from you.

Heightened (+2) The bludgeoning damage increases by 5.

name: Bind Heroic Spirit
description:
You turn one of your thralls into a conduit to bind the spirit of a hero into your body. Destroy the target thrall and gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws. Additionally, whenever you critically hit a creature with a Strike, you can create a thrall in a space adjacent to the target of the Strike, as your heroic attack inspires other spirits to join you on the battlefield.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +2.

name: Biting Words
description:
You entwine magic with your voice, causing your taunts and jibes to physically harm your enemies. You can attack with your words once when you finish Casting the Spell, and can repeat the attack once on each of your subsequent turns by taking a single action, which has the attack, concentrate, and linguistic traits. After your third attack total, the spell ends. When you attack with biting words, make a ranged spell attack roll against a creature within 30 feet, dealing 2d6 sonic damage if you hit (or double damage on a critical hit).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

name: Blazing Dive
description:
Superheated air collects under you, buoying you high into the sky before you plummet back down in a fiery comet. You Fly 15 feet straight up into the air, then Fly in a straight line to an empty space of your choice on the ground within 60 feet. When you land, blistering air blasts out from you, dealing 3d4 bludgeoning damage and 3d6 fire damage (basic Reflex save) to all creatures in a 10-foot emanation.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4 bludgeoning and 1d6 fire.

name: Blazing Fissure
description:
A thin crack rips through the earth, erupting with magma, then swiftly seals up. Each creature along the line and on solid ground takes 4d6 bludgeoning damage and 6d6 fire damage with a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage, and it falls prone.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, and it falls prone.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6 bludgeoning and 1d6 fire.

name: Blessing of Defiance
description:
Channeling forth the power to persevere in the face of adversity. Choose one saving throw: Fortitude, Reflex, or Will. The target gains a +4 status bonus to that saving throw for 1 round. The potency and number of targets of this blessing depend on how many actions you spend when Casting the Spell.

[single action] The spell targets you or one willing ally within range. [two actions] (concentrate) The spell targets you or one willing ally within range. If you choose Fortitude, the target gains resistance 15 to poison. If you choose Reflex, the target gains a +15-foot status bonus to its Speeds. If you choose Will, the target gains resistance 15 to mental damage. [three actions] (concentrate) The spell targets you and all willing allies within 30 feet.

name: Blessing of Vigor
description:
You pray for a small blessing to keep your target safe. The target gains fast healing 3.

Heightened (+1) The fast healing increases by 3.

name: Blink Charge
description:
You propel yourself through the fabric of space to deal a blow carrying the momentum of your teleportation. You teleport to an empty space adjacent to a creature you can see within range, then make a Strike against the creature with a weapon you're wielding. The Strike deals damage, plus an additional 2d8 force damage, depending on the result of your Strike.

Critical Success Double damage, plus after the Strike, you can teleport the target into an empty space up to 5 feet away from its current position. The new space must be on the ground if it started on the ground, in the air if it was flying, and so on.

Success The Strike deals full damage.

Failure The Strike deals no damage, but the target takes 1d8 force damage.

Critical Failure The Strike deals no damage, and you take 1d8 force damage.

Heightened (+2) The spell’s range increases by 60 feet, and any force damage the spell deals is increased by 1d8.

name: Blood Chestnuts
description:
With a wave of your arm, you launch a handful of sharp crimson seeds that bury themselves in the target's flesh. The target takes 3d8 piercing damage with a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half the piercing damage.

Failure The target takes full piercing damage and becomes afflicted with draining growth at stage 1.

Critical Failure The target takes double the piercing damage and becomes afflicted with draining growth at stage 2.

Draining Growth (disease) The target can't reduce their drained condition while afflicted by draining growth; Stage 1 drained 1 (1 round); Stage 2 drained 2 (1 round), Stage 3 drained 2 and 1d8 persistent bleed damage as a single chestnut tree begins to grow out of the creature's body. The target can't end this bleed damage until the tree is destroyed. The tree has AC 10 and 40 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. Once the tree is destroyed, return to stage 2.

name: Blood Infusion
description:
You pull blood and other fluid from a thrall before embedding it into another creature. You then slowly and painfully begin to extract that blood from the creature. A creature within 15 feet of the target thrall becomes filled with blood. The thrall is destroyed, and the creature must attempt a Fortitude saving throw.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target loses any immunity to bleed and is considered to be a creature with blood for the purposes of effects and requirements. The creature takes 1 persistent bleed damage.

Failure As success, but the persistent bleed damage is 1d6.

Critical Failure As success, but the persistent bleed damage is 2d6.

Heightened (+1) The persistent bleed damage increases by 1 on a success, 1d6 on a failure, and 2d6 on a critical failure.

name: Blood Runs Cold
description:
You chill the blood in the target's veins. The target takes 1d6 persistent cold damage with a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half the persistent cold damage.

Failure The target takes the full persistent cold damage and is slowed 1 for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double the persistent cold damage and is slowed 1 until the persistent cold damage ends.

Heightened (+2) Increase the persistent cold damage by 1d6.

name: Bloodspray Curse
description:
You inflict a curse upon the target that causes any wound to gush blood. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success For 1 minute, the first time each round that the target would take at least 10 piercing or slashing damage from a single Strike, the strike deals an additional 2d6 damage of the same type.

Failure As success, but the Strike also deals an additional 2d6 persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+2) The additional damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1d6.

name: Bloody Tendrils
description:
You conjure forth stationary tentacles formed from pure, partially hardened blood. You create up to 3 Medium thralls shaped like bloody tendrils in range. These tendrils are immune to physical damage and can’t move. The tendril’s Strike has a reach of 10 feet. Whenever an enemy ends it turn within the reach of one or more tendrils, the tendril lashes out at them, dealing 1d12 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+3) The number of thralls this spell can create increases by 1, and the damage increases by 1d12.

name: Blossoming Gore
description:
By spilling the blood of a thrall, you grow a large field of bloody roses that feeds on the life force of those around it and uses it to create thralls that do your bidding. This field appears in a 20-foot burst centered on a corner in the target thrall’s space, and that thrall is destroyed. A creature that enters or starts its turn in the area takes 10 persistent bleed damage from the rose’s thorns. You can Dismiss this spell. If a bleeding creature ends its turn in the area, it must attempt a Fortitude saving throw.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is drained 1.

Failure The creature is drained 1, and a single thrall is created in an unoccupied space adjacent to the field.

Critical Failure The creature becomes drained 2, and 2 thralls are created in unoccupied spaces adjacent to the field.

Heightened (+1) The persistent bleed damage increases by 2.

name: Bone Moth's Kiss
target: 1 creature with bones or a natural exoskeleton
description:
A tiny, bone-white moth emerges from your open mouth. It shakes itself off, spreads its wings, and flies toward your foe, brushing its wings against their exposed skin. The moth carries a disease that causes a victim's bones to quickly grow soft and eventually melt. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The moth only briefly brushes its wings against the target. The target is sickened 1.

Failure The moth lands on the target, kissing the spot with its fluttering. The target is afflicted with the bone moth's kiss at stage 1.

Critical Failure The moth lands on an open wound, targeting it with its kiss. The target is afflicted with the bone moth's kiss at stage 2.

Bone Moth's Kiss (disease) Stage 1 drained 1 and sickened 1 (1 round); Stage 2 drained 2 (1 round); Stage 3 drained 3 and can't recover from the drained condition until the disease is cured (1 day)

name: Bone Shield
description:
You create an expendable shield of rough, raw bone in a free hand that can easily be replaced over and over again. When you Cast the Spell or the first time each round you Sustain this spell on subsequent rounds, you can Raise this Shield, granting you a +2 circumstance bonus to AC. While this spell is in effect, you gain the Shield Block reaction, but only with the bone shield. The bone shield has Hardness 3 and 1 HP (with no Broken Threshold). This shield also gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its Hardness against attacks that deal piercing or slashing damage. If the shield is destroyed, it's recreated already raised in a free hand when you Sustain the Spell.

Heightened (+2) The shield’s Hardness increases by 3.

name: Bone Spear
description:
You shape a thrall into a spear of jagged bone. Destroy the target thrall, and each creature in a 15-foot line originating from the thrall’s former space takes 2d6 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

name: Bone Spray
description:
You fire a torrent of jagged bone shards from your hands that rips through the fleshy bodies of your enemies. The spray deals 2d10 piercing damage and 1 persistent bleed damage to all creatures in the area, with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+1) The piercing damage increases by 1d10, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

name: Bony Barrage
description:
You shatter the skeleton of a thrall, creating a volley of teeth, vertebrae, and phalanges. Destroy the target thrall, and each creature in a 30-foot cone originating from the thrall’s former space takes 2d10 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save. You can destroy a second thrall in the cone’s area to cover you and any allies in the area in bone armor. If you do, you and affected allies take no damage from this spell and gain a +1 status bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

name: Booming Blast
description: You amplify the already intense cracking noise of your gunshot to spread terror through the ranks of your foes. Make a ranged firearm Strike. Regardless of the result, each enemy in a 20-foot emanation around you must succeed at a Will save against your spell DC or be frightened 1 (or frightened 2 on a critical failure).

name: Boost Eidolon
description:
You focus deeply on the link between you and your eidolon and boost the power of your eidolon’s attacks. Your eidolon gains a +2 status bonus to damage rolls with their unarmed attacks. If your eidolon’s Strikes deal more than one weapon damage die, the status bonus increases to 2 per weapon damage die, to a maximum of +8 with four weapon damage dice.

Special Your eidolon can benefit from either boost eidolon or reinforce eidolon, but not both; if you cast one of these spells during the other's duration, the newer spell replaces the older one.

name: Bottomless Stomach
description:
You create a shimmering extradimensional space accessible from the target's mouth. The space can hold objects and equipment, up to a total of 10 Bulk. This extradimensional storage doesn't hamper the target's ability to eat, drink, speak (if applicable), or otherwise act, as it only opens and closes when the target chooses.

The target can Interact to swallow an object of up to 1 Bulk, which doesn't harm the object or the target. If the extradimensional space is full, the target can't add any more objects until first removing one or more stored objects. Organic matter and living creatures can't be stored in this space. The extradimensional storage is obvious to any creature who looks into the target's mouth, as the entryway shimmers slightly, though this doesn't clearly reveal the contents inside.

The target can Interact to spit out a single object of their choice, causing the object to fall to the ground in the target's space. The target can Interact three times in a row to spit out the entire contents of the extradimensional storage; the target doesn't have to take these actions all in the same turn, but if they take any other actions in between, the target has to start over. The items eject into the target's space, possibly spilling out into adjacent spaces if there's too much to fit.

When the spell ends or the target falls unconscious, the contents of the extradimensional storage are disgorged in a riotous spew, landing in the nearest unoccupied space, a bit wet but otherwise unharmed.

Heightened (5th) The duration increases to 8 hours.

name: Breadcrumbs
description:
You protect your target from going astray in hostile territory by tracking where they've already been, helping the target deduce where they still need to go. The target leaves a glittering trail behind them that lasts for the spell's duration. This trail doesn't denote the direction or the order of its path—it merely indicates where the target has moved during the spell's duration.

Heightened (2nd) The duration increases to 8 hours.

Heightened (3rd) The duration increases to last until your next daily preparations.

name: Bridge of Graves
description:
You summon a bridge formed from grave dirt and tombstones that allow thralls to move with great speed. The 10-foot-wide span must start at the ground on a point within range, and it extends as a horizontal plane, either in a straight line or at any angle up to 45 degrees upward or downward, for up to 120 feet. This bridge has AC 10, Hardness 30, and 40 Hit Points. A thrall on or adjacent to the bridge can move to any location on the bridge when you command it to Stride. You can Dismiss the spell.

Heightened (+1) The length of the bridge increases by 20 feet, its Hit Points increase by 20, and you can increase the width of the span by up to an additional 5 feet.

name: Burning Blossoms
description:
An intangible hollow tree grows to towering height, radiating a fiery passion and fascinating viewers. The base of the tree takes up a single square and grows 100 feet upward, while its branches extend outward 30 feet, forming the spell's cylindrical area. The tree then blossoms, growing delicate white flowers that burn with white-hot fire. As the tree's branches gently rustle in the wind, flower petals drift to the ground in a shower of flame. Any creature that ends its turn under the tree's branches takes 6d6 fire damage from the burning petals.

Any enemy that can see the tree, even if the enemy is outside the spell's area, must attempt a Will save. This is an emotion, mental, and visual effect. Creatures fascinated with the tree must use at least one of their actions on each of their turns to move toward the tree.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected, but it must attempt a new save at the end of its turn if it can still see the tree.

Failure The creature is fascinated with the tree until the end of its next turn. If it can still see the tree at the end of its turn, it must attempt a new save.

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated with the tree until the spell ends. The tree's fire damage doesn't end the fascination, but other hostile actions end it as normal. If the fascination ends, the creature must attempt a new save at the end of its turn if it can still see the tree.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

name: Burning Trail
description:
The target's feet glow with a magical flame that lingers and grows on the ground where they walk, creating a line of blazing fire as they move. The first time the target Strides during the spell's duration, they leave behind a trail made of magical fire that fills up each space they occupied during that Stride. This fire is 5 feet high. Creatures on either side of the trail are concealed from creatures on the opposite side. Any creature that enters or starts its turn in the trail's area takes 2d10 fire damage.

Heightened (+2) The fire damage increases by 1d10.

name: Calcification
description:
You transform a thrall into fine dust particles that invade a creature’s body and begin transforming their body into a statue made of pure enhanced bone. Destroy a thrall within range, and choose a living or undead creature within 60 feet of where the thrall was. The creature begins solidifying into pure bone depending on its Fortitude save. Creatures already made purely of bone, such as skeletons, are immune to this spell. An incorporeal creature slowed by this spell loses the incorporeal trait and all associated resistances for the duration of the spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is slowed 1 and has weakness 5 to bludgeoning for 1 round.

Failure The creature is slowed 1 and has weakness 10 to bludgeoning for as long as it’s slowed. The creature must attempt an additional Fortitude save at the end of each of its turns; this ongoing save has the incapacitation trait. On a failed save, the slowed condition increases by 1 (or 2 on a critical failure) as bone growths creep across the creature’s body. A successful save reduces the slowed condition by 1. When a creature becomes fully unable to act due to the slowed condition from calcification, the spell then ends, leaving the creature petrified permanently as it becomes a bony statue. The spell also ends if the slowed condition is removed, which causes the bone to break off harmlessly.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is initially slowed 2.

name: Calcium Rain
description:
You conjure a horrific cloud of tiny dancing bone shards that collapses like a torrent of rain upon those unfortunate enough to be nearby. Creatures in the area take 10d4 piercing damage and 5 persistent bleed damage (basic Reflex save).

Heightened (+1) The piercing damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

name: Call of the Quenching
description:
Legends say Aroden and Arazni called upon the Boundless Sea itself to defeat the fiery lizard Cuetzmonquali and the Army of Fire. Using yourself as the planar key, you blow the conch to call forth a boundless sea and its inhabitants to aid you. Water falls as a torrential shower, making the area of the spell difficult terrain for all enemies. You and all allies within the area gain resistance 15 to fire and are concealed. Countless sea creatures swim through the sky and attack your foes. An enemy that ends its turn within the area takes 7d4 piercing and 7d4 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex save). When you Fuel Call of the Quenching, you cast an 8th-rank summon animal spell without expending a spell slot. The animal you summon must have the amphibious or aquatic trait and gains a fly Speed equal to its swim Speed. You can Sustain any number of animals created this way whenever you Sustain this spell.

Lethologic Mark You become closely aligned with elemental water and constantly feel sluggish while away from it. You take a –5-foot status penalty to your land Speed that's suppressed when you're within 1 mile of an ocean or a portal to the Plane of Water. You heal the mark if you take damage from dragon breath from three different dragons with the primal or water trait.

Heightened (+1) The bludgeoning and piercing damage both increase by 1d4. The rank of the summon animal spell increases by 1.

name: Cast into Time
description:
You release a wave of temporal energy that sends creatures violently tumbling through time, scarring their thoughts with the information flowing around them. Although the journey can feel like it lasts for minutes or even days, the targets reappear instantly. Witnessing this chaotic flow of time and being bashed against objects from the past and future deals 5d8 mental damage and 5d6 bludgeoning damage to creatures in the area, with a Fortitude save. A creature that falls into time disappears until the end of your turn. It then reappears in the same space it left; if that space is occupied, it appears in the nearest empty space, chosen by the GM. Creatures that are immune to mental effects can still be affected by this spell but take no mental damage.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature falls into time. When it returns, it takes half damage.

Failure The creature falls into time. When it returns, it takes full damage and is sickened 1.

Critical Failure The creature falls into time. When it returns, it takes double damage and is sickened 2.

Heightened (+1) The bludgeoning damage increases by 2d6.

name: Chosen Gravity
description:
The target can change the direction gravity pulls them after they touch a surface with their feet. The target can walk on vertical surfaces or upside down as though gravity was pulling them toward the surface. In addition, the target gains a +1 status bonus to their saving throws and Fortitude DC against forced movement. When the spell ends, the target is affected by gravity as normal and might fall if not on the floor.

Heightened (6th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

name: Cinder Scribe
description:
Conjuring a quill of magical flame, you take an object and write a message onto it that disappears to the naked eye almost as soon as you finish writing it. If this message is written onto an object that can't withstand a burning fire, such as paper or leather, then the object is destroyed while you're writing it. If the inscribed object is thrust into a roaring fire, the writing on it is revealed for 1 minute before fading. The writing can be revealed this way any number of times, and it's erased only if it's counteracted by an effect similar to dispel magic or when the duration ends. Even if the object is destroyed, pieces of the message exist on its various parts. For example, if the object was turned to dust and recreated via remake, the message would remain intact.

Heightened (2nd) The duration increases to a year and a day.

Heightened (4th) The duration is unlimited.

name: Circle of Weakness
description:
Winning magical combat often requires exploiting weakness. You evoke a circle of floating inscriptions that creates and amplifies energy-based weaknesses on creatures inside the circle. Choose one type of damage from the following list: acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, or sonic. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it each turn, each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude saving throw.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature gains weakness 1 to the chosen damage type for 1 round.

Failure As success, except the weakness is doubled.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature becomes immobilized for 1 round or until they Escape.

Heightened (+2) The weakness gained on a success increases by 1.

name: Claim Curse
description: By burning threads of fate around a target and then retying them to yourself instead, you temporarily draw their curse to you, offering them brief succor from the worst of its effects. Choose a curse affecting the target that you don't already have. For 5 minutes, you're affected by the curse (at the same stage as the target, and it can't be changed, if applicable), and the target isn't. If the curse's duration ends before claim curse would, it ends as normal; otherwise, when the spell's duration ends the curse's effects return to the target as normal.

name: Clone Companion
description:
You create a duplicate of your companion that fights alongside its twin, mirroring the original's actions. The duplicate appears adjacent to your companion and has the same statistics.

Each time you Command your companion, both your companion and its duplicate gain 2 actions. The duplicate always acts immediately after your companion and must use identical actions to the ones your companion used, in exactly the same order. However, it can use the actions differently, such as Striding to a different position or selecting a different target for a Strike. If the duplicate is unable to mimic an action, it performs the action without result, and the action is wasted. The duplicate can't use any actions that can be used only a limited number of times per day.

The duplicate isn't truly alive and can't be healed in any way. If the duplicate ever reaches 0 Hit Points, it's instantly destroyed, and clone companion ends immediately.

name: Comet Charge
description:
Wreathed in elemental power, you launch yourself toward a target to deliver a mighty blow. You Fly up to 120 feet in a straight line to an empty space adjacent to the target creature and make a melee spell attack. This movement doesn't trigger reactions, and you can fly through other creatures as part of this movement. If you began this movement at a higher elevation than your target, it's off-guard against this attack. When you Cast this Spell, choose one of the elemental effects below. The spell gains the traits listed, and the melee spell attack gains the chosen elemental effect.

  • Comet of Acid (acid, earth) You’re wreathed in blistering acid. If you hit, the target takes 6d6 acid damage and 4d6 persistent acid damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage.
  • Comet of Fire (fire) You’re wreathed in a fiery blaze. If you hit, the target takes 14d6 fire damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage.
  • Comet of Ice (cold, water) You’re wreathed in a freezing mist. If you hit, the target takes 12d6 cold damage and takes a –15-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage.
  • Comet of Lightning (air, electricity) You’re wreathed in jolting electricity. If you hit, the target takes 6d12 electricity damage and is dazzled for 1 round. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage.
  • Comet of Rust (metal) You’re wreathed in a cloud of rust. If you hit, the target takes 10d8 slashing damage, or 10d10 slashing damage if the target is wearing metal armor or is primarily made of metal. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage.
  • Comet of Splinters (wood) You’re wreathed in painful splinters. If you hit, the target takes 10d6 piercing damage and is clumsy 1 for 1 minute. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage. The target can Interact to remove the splinters and end the clumsy condition inflicted by this spell.

name: Companion's Shadow
description: The shadow of your companion joins in the fight. The first time your companion Strikes each round, their shadow can also make an unarmed Strike against a different creature within range using the same multiple attack penalty as the original attack. The shadow's Strike deals void damage instead of any other damage type the Strike would normally do. Both attacks contribute to your companion's multiple attack penalty as normal.

name: Conglomerate of Limbs
description:
You conjure forth a humongous thrall consisting solely of undead severed limbs. You create a Huge thrall within range. This thrall has 40 Hit Points and a Speed of 25 feet. When you use thrall charge to order this thrall to make a Strike, it makes two melee unarmed Strikes instead of one, each against a different creature within 10 feet. Your multiple attack penalty doesn’t increase until after the thrall makes both Strikes. A creature hit by one of these Strikes must also succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or become grabbed by the thrall for 1 round (or restrained on a critical failure) or until it Escapes. Attempts to Escape don’t automatically succeed, and the Escape DC is your spell DC.

Heightened (+1) The thrall’s Hit Points increase by 10.

name: Conjurer's Countermeasure
duration: until the end of your next turn
description:
You quickly create a barrier that protects you against the magic of spellcraft. You gain resistance 5 against damage from spells.

The resistance from this spell is cumulative with that of Arcane Cascade. If you’re in Arcane Cascade stance when the duration of conjurer’s countermeasure expires, the spell’s duration extends until Arcane Cascade ends.

Heightened (+3) The resistance increases by 5.

name: Coral Eruption
description:
Razor sharp coral erupts from the ground, transforming the landscape into a dangerous coral reef. You can create a third nonoverlapping burst if the centers of all three bursts are underwater. Creatures in the area when the spell is cast take 6d6 piercing damage and must attempt a basic Reflex save. A creature that critically fails its saving throw also takes 1d6 persistent bleed damage. The area becomes difficult terrain and hazardous terrain. A creature that moves through the area takes 3 piercing damage for every square of that area it moves into.

Heightened (+2) The initial piercing damage increases by 3d6, and the hazardous terrain damage increases by 1.

name: Corpse Bloom
description:
You conjure three deadly clusters of flesh-devouring fungi. Whenever a creature starts its turn in one of the clusters or the first time a creature enters a cluster each round, it takes 3d4 poison damage with a Fortitude save as poisonous spores fill the air. Corpses within a cluster rapidly decompose.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and becomes sickened 1.

Failure The target takes full damage and becomes sickened 1.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and becomes sickened 2.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

name: Cosmic Form
description:
You recreate your form entirely out of cosmic energy, transforming into a Large battle form. You must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. When you Cast this Spell, choose to take on the powers of the moon or the sun. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose: AC = 21 + your level. Ignore your armor check's penalty and Speed reduction.20 temporary Hit Points.Darkvision.One or more attacks specific to the battle form you use, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +25, and your damage bonus is +10. The melee attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example), and the ranged attacks are Dexterity based. If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.Athletics modifier of +25, unless your own is higher.You also gain specific abilities based on the stellar body:

  • Moon Speed 30 feet, fly 50 feet; Melee [single action] fist (agile, reach 10 feet, unarmed), Damage 2d4 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire; Ranged [single action] moonbeam (range 90 feet), Damage 2d4 fire; this form’s fire damage is silver for resistances, weaknesses, and the like; on a critical hit with either Strike, the target is stupefied 2 for 1 round.
  • Sun Speed 30 feet, fly 50 feet; Melee [single action] fist (agile, reach 10 feet, unarmed), Damage 2d6 fire plus 1d6 persistent fire; Ranged [single action] sunbeam (range 90 feet), Damage 1d6 fire plus 1d6 persistent fire; on a critical hit with either Strike, the target is dazzled for 1 round.

name: Cradle Aloft
target: 1 held object of 2 Bulk or less
description: You temporarily release gravity's hold on an object, allowing you to let go of it without dropping it to the floor. The object floats next to you in your space, following you if you move. You can Interact to retrieve the object on your turn as a free action. If you're within reach of another creature, that creature can spend a single action with the attack trait to attempt an Athletics check against your spell DC, retrieving the object out of the air on a success. The creature must have a free hand to attempt this check. The spell ends if a creature successfully retrieves the object. If the object is floating when the spell ends, it falls.

name: Create Earthen Facsimile
description: You hold a clump of soil, and it morphs into a small figurine in your hand. The soil transforms and hardens into a simple form of your choosing. While it does hold its shape if undisturbed, the figurine is brittle and will crumble under pressure or turn back to mush at the end of the spell's duration.

name: Create Thrall
description: You conjure forth the undead. You either create 2 thralls in unoccupied squares within range or create 1 thrall and immediately Command that Thrall.

name: Crucible of Iron
description:
You call forth a crucible of molten iron that pours over the target, burning them as the metal quickly covers and encases their body. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's head is encased in iron, causing them to be dazzled for 1 round and take 1d10 persistent fire damage.

Failure The target's head, arms, and chest are all encased. The target is dazzled and enfeebled 1 for 1 minute or until they Escape. They also take 1d10 persistent fire damage.

Critical Failure The target's legs and feet are also encased. The target is dazzled, enfeebled 2, and immobilized for 1 minute or until they Escape. They also take 1d10 persistent fire damage.

Heightened (+2) The persistent fire damage increases by 1d10.

name: Cryostasis
description:
You encase a dying creature in a protective layer of enchanted ice, halting their descent toward death. The target is completely frozen in ice and remains unconscious but stable. For the duration of the spell, they don't attempt recovery checks or take persistent damage. The creature can't act, speak, or perceive anything while in this state and doesn't need to breathe, eat food, or drink water to remain alive. You can Dismiss the spell to shatter the ice and release the target.

The ice block has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 60 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. While the ice remains unbroken, the encased creature can't take damage or be the target of spells. If the ice is destroyed, the spell ends immediately, though the creature is stabilized.

Heightened (8th) The duration becomes unlimited, and the ice block’s Hit Points increase by 20.

name: Crystallized Vapors
description:
You freeze the precipitation around you in icy pellets, creating a 15-foot emanation of difficult terrain; you're immune to this difficult terrain. You can launch a ball of ice whenever you Cast this Spell and the first time you Sustain this spell on subsequent turns, making a ranged spell attack against the AC of a creature within 30 feet. On a hit, you deal 1d12 cold damage and 1d12 bludgeoning damage (or double damage on a critical hit).

Heightened (+3) The damage increases by 1d12 cold and 1d12 bludgeoning.

name: Daemon Form
description:
You infuse yourself with the corrupting death and pure malevolence of Abaddon, transforming into a Large daemon battle form. You must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. When you Cast this Spell, you choose lacridaemon, leukodaemon, meladaemon, or venedaemon. The battle form is Medium if you choose lacridaemon or venedaemon. While in this form, you gain the daemon, fiend, and unholy traits. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose: AC = 21 + your level. Ignore your armor check's penalty and Speed reduction.20 temporary Hit Points and weakness 5 to holy.A +2 status bonus to all saving throws against death effects.Resistance 10 to poison.Darkvision.One or more attacks specific to the battle form you use, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +21, and your damage bonus is +12. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.Athletics modifier of +23, unless your own modifier is higher.You also gain specific abilities based on the type of Daemon you choose:

  • Lacridaemon Speed 25 feet, fly 40 feet; resistance 10 to cold; Melee [single action] jaws (magical, unholy), Damage 1d8 piercing plus 1d6 cold and 1d4 poison; Melee [single action] claw (agile, magical, unholy), Damage 1d6 slashing plus 1d6 cold.
  • Leukodaemon Speed 25 feet, fly 40 feet; +2 status bonus to saves against diseases; Melee [single action] jaws (magical, reach 10 feet, unholy), Damage 2d10 piercing; Melee [single action] claw (agile, magical, reach 10 feet, unholy), Damage 2d6 slashing; Ranged [single action] composite longbow (deadly d10, magical, range increment 100 feet, unholy, volley), Damage 2d8 piercing.
  • Meladaemon Speed 25 feet, fly 40 feet; Melee [single action] jaws (magical, reach 10 feet, unholy), Damage 2d10 piercing; Melee [single action] claw (agile, magical, reach 10 feet, unholy, void), Damage 1d6 slashing plus 1d6 void, and after a successful Strike, you can spend an action to attempt to Grab the target.
  • Venedaemon Speed 25 feet; sense magical items and active spells within 60 feet as an imprecise sense; Melee [single action] tentacle (agile, magical, reach 10 feet, unholy), Damage 2d6 bludgeoning.

name: Day's Weight
description:
You fast-forward time for a single creature, burdening it with the aches and pain of an entire day and temporarily making it tired and weak. The creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is fatigued and enfeebled 1 for 1 round.

Failure The target is fatigued and enfeebled 1 for the duration.

Critical Failure The target is fatigued and enfeebled 2 for the duration. The fatigued condition doesn't end when the spell's duration does (but can still be removed with a night's rest or by similar means).

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

name: Dead Weight
description:
You command a thrall to hurl itself on another creature, fusing their flesh together. The target thrall launches itself at a creature within 15 feet, and the target must attempt a Fortitude saving throw. The target thrall is destroyed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is off-guard.

Failure The target is slowed 1 and off-guard.

Critical Failure The target is slowed 2 and off-guard.

name: Deathly Scream
description:
Your thrall lets forth a spectral scream that pierces the mind. While the sound is loud, only those closest can feel the true sting of death in it. Each creature within a 5-foot emanation of the target thrall takes 1d4 mental damage depending on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is frightened 1.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is frightened 2.

Heightened (+1) The mental damage increases by 1d4.

name: Decompose
description:
You touch a corpse to speed up the decaying process. The target begins to rapidly decompose. After a day, any organic material will be gone, and after a week, any trace of the target will be gone.

Heightened (3rd) Organic material is gone within a minute, and any trace of the target is gone within an hour.

name: Defensive Prescience
description:
Your eyes widen as you watch the attack, slowing it down in your mind as you look at the possibilities that lie ahead. Reaching out, you twist the strands of fate, creating a glitch in this instance to protect your vulnerable familiar. The target must attempt a Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature must roll twice and use the worse result on its attack roll; if its attack is a critical failure, the target takes 3d10 force damage.

Critical Failure The creature must roll twice and use the worse result on its attack roll; if its attack is a failure, the target takes 3d10 force damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

name: Defy the Gods
description:
You've obtained your abilities through sheer mental effort, unaided by any higher powers, and now you drain away what the undeserving have gained through divine shortcuts. If the target has the divine, holy, or unholy trait and becomes drained by this spell, you gain resistance 15 to holy and unholy for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is drained 1 and stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Failure The creature is drained 2 and stupefied 2 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is drained 3 and stupefied 3 for 1 minute.

name: Deity's Strike
description:
A manifested version of your deity's favored weapon made of pure magical might appears in the air above the target. This weapon attacks using your spell attack modifier. On a hit, the weapon deals 7d12 force damage, or double damage on a critical hit.

After the attack, whether it succeeds or fails, divine energy bursts from the weapon in a shock wave. It emits in a 10-foot-wide, 30-foot-long line starting from the target and continuing in a direction you choose. Your target and any other creatures within the area of the spell take 5d6 spirit damage, with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (9th) The force damage increases by 1d12, and the spirit damage increases by 1d6.

name: Demon Form
description:
You corrupt yourself with the sin of the Outer Rifts, transforming into a Medium demon battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose abrikandilu, brimorak, kithangian, or vloriak. If you choose kithangian, the battle form is Large, and you must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. While in this form, you gain the demon, fiend, and unholy traits. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose: AC = 20 + your level. Ignore your armor check's penalty and Speed reduction.30 temporary Hit Points, weakness 5 to cold iron, and weakness 5 to holy.Darkvision.One or more attacks specific to the battle form you use, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +22, and your damage bonus is +12. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your attack modifier is higher for the given unarmed attack or weapon, you can use it instead.Athletics modifier of +23, unless your own modifier is higher.You also gain specific abilities based on the type of demon you choose:

  • Abrikandilu Speed 25 feet; Melee [single action] jaws (magical, unarmed, unholy), Damage 2d6 piercing, and clumsy 1 for 1 minute on a critical hit; Melee [single action] claw (agile, magical, unarmed, unholy), Damage 2d6 slashing; Ranged [single action] hurled debris (range increment 20 feet, unholy), Damage 2d6 bludgeoning.
  • Brimorak Speed 30 feet; Melee [single action] flaming sword (magical, unholy), Damage 2d8 slashing plus 1d6 fire; Melee [single action] hoof (agile, unarmed, unholy), Damage 2d4 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire.
  • Kithangian Speed 30 feet; Melee [single action] pincer (magical, reach 10 feet, unarmed, unholy), Damage 1d12 slashing, and after a successful Strike you can spend an action to attempt to Grab the target; Melee [single action] stinger (agile, magical, reach 10 feet, unarmed, unholy), Damage 1d8 piercing; all melee Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to animals.
  • Vloriak Speed 25 feet; resistance 10 to acid; Melee [single action] claw (unarmed, unholy), Damage 2d6 piercing plus 1d6 spirit; Melee [single action] tongue (agile, reach 10 feet, unarmed, unholy), Damage 1d6 acid plus 1d6 spirit.

name: Devil Form
description:
You bind yourself to the power of Hell, transforming into a Medium devil battle form. When you Cast this Spell, choose coarti, levaloch, sarglagon, or vordine. If you choose levaloch or sarglagon, the battle form is Large, and you must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. While in this form, you gain the devil, fiend, and unholy traits. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of the form that you choose: AC = 22 + your level. Ignore your armor check's penalty and Speed reduction.5 temporary Hit Points, resistance 5 to physical damage (except silver), and weakness 5 to holy.Resistance 10 to fire.Darkvision.One or more attacks specific to the battle form you use, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +20, and your damage bonus is +12. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your attack modifier is higher for the given unarmed attack or weapon, you can use it instead.Athletics modifier of +23, unless your own modifier is higher. You also gain specific abilities based on the type of devil you choose:

  • Coarti Speed 25 feet, fly 40 feet; Melee [single action] morningstar (magical, unholy, versatile P), Damage 2d6 bludgeoning plus 1d6 spirit; Melee [single action] wing (agile, unarmed, unholy, versatile P), Damage 1d6 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire.
  • Levaloch Speed 30 feet, climb 30 feet; +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude DC against being Shoved and to other saving throws to resist being moved against your will; Melee [single action] trident (magical, unholy), Damage 2d8 piercing; Ranged [single action] trident (magical, thrown 20 feet, unholy), Damage 2d8 piercing; all melee Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to clumsy, enfeebled, immobilized, or restrained creatures.
  • Sarglagon Speed 25 feet, fly 25 feet, swim 30 feet; Melee [single action] fangs (magical, unarmed, unholy), Damage 2d10 piercing; Melee [single action] tentacle arm (agile, magical, unarmed, unholy), Damage 1d8 bludgeoning plus 1d6 poison.
  • Vordine Speed 25 feet; Melee [single action] trident (magical, unholy), Damage 2d8 piercing; Melee [single action] hoof (agile, magical, unarmed, unholy), Damage 1d4 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire; Melee [single action] whip (disarm, magical, nonlethal, reach 10 feet, trip, unholy), Damage 2d4 slashing; Ranged [single action] trident (magical, thrown 20 feet, unholy), Damage 2d8 piercing.

name: Dimensional Assault
description:
You tumble through a small rift in space itself, making a short dimensional hop to better position yourself for a devastating surprise attack. Teleport to any space in range you can see that’s within reach of an enemy, and then make a melee Strike against that enemy. If you attempt to bring another creature with you when you teleport—even if you’re carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is disrupted.

Heightened (5th) The range is equal to your Speed.

name: Dimensional Drop
description:
You place a portal on the ground directly beneath a creature. That target immediately plummets into extradimensional space, falling a distance through an infinite, featureless void before being forcibly ejected from a portal that appears right above their original space and taking the appropriate fall damage. The target must attempt a Reflex saving throw. The DC to Arrest a Fall is equal to your spell DC.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target falls 10 feet through the void before reappearing.

Failure The target falls 20 feet through the void before reappearing.

Critical Failure The target falls 40 feet through the void before reappearing.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 5 creatures within range.

name: Disintegrating Puddle
description:
You spit out a green glob of dangerous acid that increases in size as it flies at the target, splashing around them as it hits them. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a success, the target takes 2d12 acid damage, and acid splatters to the ground in the target's space and all spaces adjacent to the target. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage. The acid puddle lasts for 1 minute; a creature that enters or starts its turn in the acid puddle takes 1d4 acid damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial acid damage increases by 2d12, and the acid puddle damage increases by 1d4.

name: Disorienting Flash
description:
You create a small explosion of bright light and ear-piercing sound that rocks the senses. Creatures in the area take sonic damage with a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines the damage and other parameters.

[single action] This spell deals 1d10 sonic damage, and its area is a 5-foot square. Creatures that fail their save become dazzled until the end of your next turn. [two actions] This spell deals 2d10 sonic damage, and its area is a 10- foot burst. Creatures that fail their save become dazzled until the end of your next turn. [three actions] This spell deals 2d10 sonic damage, and its area is a 20- foot burst. Creatures that fail their save become dazzled and deafened until the end of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10 for all versions.

name: Divine Armageddon
description:
You call forth a divine cataclysm from your deity, destroying living and undead creatures in the area alike. Creatures in the area take 10d6 void damage and 10d6 spirit damage. A creature harmed by vitality damage, such as one with void healing, takes vitality damage instead of void damage from this spell.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6 void damage and 1d6 spirit damage.

name: Dome of Tranquility
description:
The air around you falls still and blocks out the sounds of the outside world. While you can clearly hear anything within this isolated dome, you can't hear anything outside of it. The opposite is also true, with no one outside of your dome being able to hear what's within. This dome doesn't block line of sight. If anything larger than 1 Bulk passes through it, the dome is automatically dispersed. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (3rd) The duration increases to 8 hours.

Heightened (5th) The duration increases to 24 hours.

name: Doom Mark
description:
You launch a dart of dark void energy that imprints itself on the target, connecting the fates of those marked. Whenever you Cast this Spell and the first time you Sustain this spell on subsequent turns, make a ranged spell attack against the AC of a creature within 60 feet. On a hit, you deal 6d8 void damage (or double damage on a critical hit) and place a mark on their body for the duration of the spell. A marked creature is enfeebled 1 and stupefied 1. When a marked creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points, all other marked creatures become off-guard and clumsy 1 for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

name: Draw Blood
description:
The palm of your hand grows a mouth with impossibly long fangs that ache to drink your enemies' blood. Make a melee spell attack against a target. On a hit, you deal 4d4 piercing damage and 2 persistent bleed damage (or double damage on a critical hit). For the duration of the spell, you regain 2 Hit Points each time the target takes bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The piercing damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage and healing increase by 1.

name: Draw the Lightning
target: 1 creature that’s either taller than you or higher in the air than you
description:
Calling out to the skies, you summon a bolt of lightning to strike through a foe above you and channel the energy down into your weapon or body, charging it with electrical power. You must hold your weapon or an empty hand aloft as part of Casting this Spell. When you do, a bolt of lightning descends from a storm cloud in the air above you and through the target, dealing 3d12 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save. For the rest of the spell's duration, your first Strike each round with the weapon you held aloft (or with your unarmed attacks if you held an empty hand aloft) deals an additional 1d12 electricity damage.

The spell creates its own storm cloud if necessary, so you can cast draw the lightning anywhere, even underground. If draw the lightning is cast outside under a cloudy or stormy sky, increase the bolt's damage by 2d12.

Heightened (8th) The damage dealt to the initial target increases by 4d12, and the additional damage dealt on the first Strike each turn increases by 1d12.

name: Dread Mosquito Storm
description:
You release a plague of terrible undead mosquitoes over a massive area that exposes creatures to their necrotic blood disease. A creature that enters or starts its turn in the area takes 1 void damage and must attempt a Fortitude saving throw.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target is afflicted with necrotic blood at stage 1. It automatically recovers from the disease after 1 round, except that any sickened condition it has remains.

Failure The target is afflicted with necrotic blood at stage 1.

Critical Failure The target is afflicted with necrotic blood at stage 2. Necrotic Blood (disease, thrall) Level 18; If an afflicted creature dies, you create a thrall in its space of the same size as the creature; Maximum Duration 6 rounds; Stage 1 3d10 void damage, sickened 1, and the creature gains weakness 5 to bleed damage (1 round); Stage 2 4d10 void damage, sickened 2, and the creature gains weakness 10 to bleed damage; Stage 3 5d10 void damage, sickened 3, and the creature gains weakness 20 to bleed damage (1 round)

name: Earthbreaker Stride
description:
The ground parts for you as you move. You gain a burrow Speed equal to your land Speed; you can burrow through solid stone and structures made entirely of rock or stone, though you treat such substances as difficult terrain. When you Burrow, you leave behind a stable tunnel that's 5 feet wide and 10 feet tall. You can't Burrow further than 100 feet from the nearest surface.

You can Dismiss the spell at any point to collapse the tunnel, which pushes anyone within out through the nearest exit. If the tunnel remains at the end of the spell's duration, it remains as an ordinary, non-magical tunnel.

name: Echoing Weapon
description:
You channel energy into the target weapon, and the air around it faintly hums each time it strikes a blow, as the impact is absorbed into the weapon. If a creature is wielding the weapon at the end of its turn, the weapon discharges a burst of sound targeting one creature adjacent to the wielder. The sonic damage dealt is equal to the number of successful Strikes with the target weapon that the wielder made that turn (to a maximum of 4 sonic damage if the wielder hits with four Strikes).

Heightened (+2) The sonic damage increases by 1 per Strike (and the maximum damage increases by 4).

name: Eidolon's Wrath
description:
Your eidolon releases a powerful explosion of energy that deals 5d6 damage of the type you chose when you took the Eidolon’s Wrath feat, with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

name: Electrostatic Glider
description: You generate an arc of static electricity above you, allowing you to ride air currents and descend gracefully, though it doesn't provide actual flight. During this spell's duration, you can glide as a single action that has the move trait. When you glide, you move 5 feet down and 25 feet through the air, though you can control the direction you travel. As long as you spend at least 1 action gliding each round and haven't yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn. At the GM's discretion, strong winds might affect your movements. If the spell ends while you're in the air, you fall normally.

name: Element Embodied
description:
Drawing upon the elemental plane, you transform into a spectacular elemental. You can choose between an air elemental, earth elemental, fire elemental, metal elemental, water elemental, or wood elemental. Your battle form is Gargantuan, and you must have enough space to expand into, or the spell is lost. While in this form, you gain the elemental trait and the trait for the element you choose. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose: AC = 25 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.30 temporary Hit Points.Darkvision.One or more attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +34, and your damage bonus is +15. These attacks are Dexterity based if you choose an air, fire, or metal elemental, or Strength based if you choose an earth, water, or wood elemental. (This distinction doesn't change the statistics but matters for the enfeebled and clumsy conditions, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.Acrobatics modifier of +36 for air, fire, or metal elemental, or Athletics modifier of +36 for earth, water, or wood elemental, unless your own modifier is higher.You also gain specific abilities based on the type of elemental you choose:

  • Air Elemental Speed fly 80 feet; High Winds (air, aura) 30 feet. Air within the emanation is difficult terrain for flying creatures that don’t have the air trait; Swiftness Your movement doesn’t trigger reactions; Melee [single action] gust (reach 25 feet), Damage 3d12 bludgeoning plus Push 10 feet; Ranged [single action] lightning lash (range increment 80 feet), Damage 3d10 electricity.
  • Earth Elemental Speed 30 feet, burrow 20 feet; resistance 5 to physical; Spike Stones (aura, earth) 30 feet. The area is difficult terrain and hazardous terrain. A creature without the earth trait that moves on the ground in the area takes 5 piercing damage for every square of that area it moves into; Rocky Toughness You gain 40 temporary Hit Points when you choose this form instead of 30; Melee [single action] fist (reach 25 feet), Damage 3d12 bludgeoning; Ranged [single action] rock (range increment 40 feet), Damage 3d8 bludgeoning.
  • Fire Elemental Speed 50 feet; immunity to fire; weakness 10 to cold; Intense Heat (aura, fire) 30 feet. A creature that enters the aura or starts its turn in the aura takes 5d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC. A creature can take damage from the aura only once per round; Melee [single action] tendril (reach 25 feet), Damage 3d10 fire plus 2d6 persistent fire; Ranged [single action] fire mote (range increment 60 feet), Damage 3d8 fire.
  • Metal Elemental Speed 40 feet, fly 40 feet; resistance 10 to electricity; Arcing Electricity (aura, electricity, metal) 30 feet. A creature that enters the aura or starts its turn in the aura takes 2d12 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC; a creature made of metal, with the metal trait, or wearing metal armor takes a –1 circumstance penalty on this save. A creature can take damage from the aura only once per round; Melee [single action] blade (reach 25 feet, versatile S), Damage 3d12 piercing; Ranged [single action] metal shard (range increment 40 feet, versatile S), Damage 3d8 piercing.
  • Water Elemental Speed 40 feet, swim 80 feet; resistance 10 to fire; Vortex (aura, water) 30 feet. Water within the aura that is part of the same body of water you occupy is difficult terrain for Swimming creatures that don’t have the water trait; Melee [single action] wave (reach 25 feet), Damage 3d12 bludgeoning plus Push or Pull 10 feet; Ranged [single action] water spout (range increment 60 feet), Damage 3d8 bludgeoning.
  • Wood Elemental Speed 30 feet, climb 35 feet; resistance 5 to physical; weakness 10 to axes; Lush Growth (aura, wood) 30 feet. Ground in the area is difficult terrain, and any time a creature in the area regains HP from a healing vitality effect, the aura grants a +5 status bonus to the healing; Woody Toughness You gain 40 temporary Hit Points when you choose this form instead of 30; Melee [single action] branch (reach 25 feet), Damage 3d10 bludgeoning; Ranged [single action] seed (range increment 40 feet), Damage 3d8 bludgeoning.

name: Elemental Absorption
description:
You absorb elemental energy, which you can release as a powerful counterattack. Choose air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood. You gain resistance 5 to damage dealt by effects with the chosen elemental trait; if you choose water, you also gain resistance 5 to cold damage. As usual, if a spell has multiple effects, such as a spell that deals both fire damage and bludgeoning damage with superheated rocks, you gain resistance to only the effects associated with the element you chose. Keep track of how much damage you've prevented with this spell.

As a 2-action activity, which has the concentrate trait and the trait matching the element you chose, you can release the stored energy. This deals damage equal to the amount you've prevented (maximum 30) to one enemy within 60 feet, with a basic Reflex save. The damage type depends on the element you chose: bludgeoning or slashing damage for air; bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage for earth; fire damage for fire; electricity or slashing damage for metal; bludgeoning or cold damage for water; or bludgeoning or vitality damage for wood. After releasing the energy, the spell ends. If you don't use the stored energy before the spell ends, the energy is lost.

Heightened (+3) The resistance increases by 5, and the maximum damage increases by 30.

name: Elemental Confluence
description:
You conjure six types of elementals who combine forces to form a chaotic storm. The confluence has AC 28, 120 Hit Points, weakness 10 to area effects, and immunity to bleed and poison. Creatures can move through the confluence; creatures within the confluence are concealed, and all creatures outside the confluence are concealed to creatures within it. When you Cast or Sustain this Spell, you can move the confluence up to 20 feet and choose up to two different types of elementals to act.

  • Air (air, electricity) Bolts of electricity burst from the confluence, dealing 4d4 electricity damage to creatures within 20 feet of the confluence, with a basic Reflex save. This doesn’t affect creatures that are completely inside of the confluence.
  • Earth (earth) The confluence gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and resistance 10 to all physical damage (except adamantine) for 1 round.
  • Fire (fire) Flames roar through the confluence, dealing 1d6 persistent fire damage to those partially or entirely inside the confluence.
  • Metal (metal) The elemental flings shards of metal through the confluence, dealing 2d6 slashing damage to those partially or entirely inside the confluence with a basic Reflex save. A creature that critically fails also takes 1d6 persistent bleed damage.
  • Water (attack, water) The elemental expels a powerful jet of water. Attempt a ranged spell attack against a target inside or within 60 feet of the confluence, using your spell attack modifier. This attack ignores concealment granted by the confluence, and the elemental gets a +2 circumstance bonus on the spell attack roll against a target inside the confluence. The water deals 4d6 bludgeoning damage on a hit (doubled on a critical hit). This attack doesn’t count toward your multiple attack penalty.
  • Wood (wood) Roots and stumps grow, making ground in the area difficult terrain for 1 round.

name: Elemental Gift
description:
An elemental force fills your target, granting them the swiftness of air, the ruggedness of earth, the sting of fire, the conductivity of metal, the flexibility of water, or the vigor of wood depending on which element you choose. Choose an element when you Cast the Spell. The target gains the benefit of that element as described below, and this spell gains that trait's element.

  • Air The target gains a +30-foot status bonus to their land Speed and gains a fly Speed equal to their land Speed without the status bonus.
  • Earth While on the ground, the target gains a +2 status bonus to Fortitude and Reflex saves against effects that would Shove or Trip them, and to saves against effects that would attempt to knock them prone. In addition, the ground adjacent to the target is difficult terrain, and the difficult terrain moves with the target, though the target ignores this difficult terrain with their own movement.
  • Fire The target’s melee unarmed Strikes and melee weapon Strikes deal 1d6 persistent fire damage on a hit.
  • Metal The target’s Strikes using a metal weapon or an unarmed attack deal an additional 1d4 electricity damage on a hit, and they get a +1 status bonus to the attack roll if the target of the attack is made of metal or wearing metal armor.
  • Water The target takes on a watery sheen, gaining resistance 5 to fire and a swim Speed equal to their land Speed.
  • Wood The target gains a number of temporary Hit Points equal to the spell’s rank, then gains half that number of temporary HP at the start of each of their turns.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to five willing creatures with the same gift.

name: Elemental Zone
description:
Select an elemental trait: air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood. Elemental zone gains the trait you chose. You imbue the area with the raw energy of that element, creating a zone that emits and amplifies magic of that type. The temperature might suddenly rise or fall, a storm cloud might form, and so on. Spells with the chosen elemental trait cast against creatures in the zone get a +2 status bonus to one damage type the spell deals based on the chosen trait: bludgeoning or electricity for air, bludgeoning for earth, fire for fire, electricity or slashing for metal, bludgeoning or cold for water, and bludgeoning or vitality for wood. The caster chooses one type to add the bonus to if the spell deals more than one eligible type. This bonus is halved if the spell didn't use a spell slot (such as a cantrip, focus spell, or innate spell).

The zone has no effect on the spell if the spell doesn't deal any damage of an eligible type.

Heightened (+2) The status bonus increases by 1.

name: Ember Doppelgänger
description:
Sending forth swirls of fire and smoke, you summon a magical glowing being in an unoccupied space that resembles your form, though not your features. This duplicate is a creature created from the ashes of battle and glowing embers, dressed in a cloak of smoke. It has AC 10; 50 Hit Points; is immune to critical hits, precision damage, and the immobilized, prone, and restrained conditions; and has weakness 10 to cold and water. This creature doesn't provide or benefit from flanking and automatically fails all skill checks and saving throws, and all skill checks attempted against it automatically succeed. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it each turn on subsequent rounds, the duplicate Strides up to 30 feet and launches a blast of fire in a 10-foot burst up to 30 feet away. Each creature in the burst takes 6d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex saving throw, using your spell DC.

Heightened (+1) The duplicate has an additional 10 Hit Points, and the damage increases by 1d6.

name: Envenom Companion
description:
You envenom your companion or eidolon's attacks, which drip with highly toxic venom for the spell's duration. The first time each round the target hits a creature with an unarmed Strike that deals piercing or slashing damage, that Strike deals an additional 1d8 poison damage. A creature that's damaged by this poison must attempt a Fortitude save against your spell DC. On a failure, it's also clumsy 1 for 1 round.

This spell can't target familiars.

Heightened (+3) The poison damage increases by 1d8, and the clumsy value imposed on a failed save increases by 1.

name: Evolution Surge
description:
You flood your eidolon with power, creating a temporary evolution in your eidolon’s capabilities. Choose one of the following effects.
